items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet ruled out with knee injury after being carted off in TNF vs Patriots; coach Ben Johnson said it did not look good.
items.why: Carted off after hit on reception, unable to put weight on right knee; immediately ruled out.
items.implication: Loveland and Burden see expanded TE/WR opportunity in Bears offense.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes/targets for Loveland as primary TE; Burden blocking/receiving upside.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice early Thursday due to a calf injury and is listed as limited.
items.why: Exited practice with calf issue amid Adams absence.
items.implication: Monitor Friday report; potential limited role or GTD vs LV, elevating TE usage.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, more targets to Higbee/Parkinson short-term.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially didn’t practice for a second straight day due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: High risk of missing another game; Worthy/others elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased target share for Worthy and remaining WRs if OUT.

items.text: Breece Hall back to practice (Thursday injury report).
items.implication: Trending toward playing vs MIA; monitor share with Allen.

items.text: Seahawks activated Zach Charbonnet off PUP; full practices, possible Week 7 debut vs KC (not guaranteed).
items.implication: Potential split with Walker; handcuff value if plays.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/committee upside; Walker snap share risk.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in team meetings, lifting, medical at facility (non-football); MarShawn Lloyd 49th and Kaleb Johnson 53rd in EPA/rush among qualifiers, OL mess.
items.why: Facility access positive sign post-layoff; backups inefficient.
items.implication: Favorable long-term/ROS outlook for Jacobs once cleared; fade Lloyd/Johnson.
items.opportunity: Jacobs workload rebound potential when active.

items.text: Saquon Barkley is in line to play vs DAL (RB15 rank); efficient in full games played, Dallas good RB matchup.
items.why: Expected to play Monday; prior efficiency.
items.implication: RB2 with upside if full go.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries vs soft run D.

items.text: Giants starting JJ McCarthy; YPT to Justin Jefferson with McCarthy only 5.7 vs 9.9+ with prior QBs (Mullens/Cousins/Darnold/Wentz).
items.why: Small sample but stark efficiency drop with McCarthy.
items.implication: Concern for Jefferson production under new starter/scheme.
items.conflict: Room for improvement noted but data concerning.

items.text: With Terrance Ferguson recovery delayed (not ready next week), Rams' answer is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game post-Adams injury.
items.why: Ferguson IR delay removes primary TE beneficiary; Adams out 6-10 weeks.
items.implication: Nuclear target volume for Nacua ROS.

items.text: Colston Loveland getting the usage over last few games projected entering season.
items.implication: Rising TE option, especially with Kmet OUT.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): back in real role with high target share/routes; Bears defense allows yardage.
items.why: 33% target share, 97% routes in prior; matchup vs Bears.

items.text: Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11): elite volume in good spot.
Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6), Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12): big workloads/friendly matchups (Lions/Saints/Bucs/CAR defenses carved up).
Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (workload post-layoff), Rome Odunze vs NE, Josh Downs @ MIN (target share/low-scoring), Travis Kelce @ SEA (tough D), Cam Skattebo @ HOU (brutal spot/role).
items.conflict: Levitan more positive on Jacobs facility access.
